latest_news.headline: Draft US-Iran deal would reopen Hormuz

latest_news.text: Reuters/AJ say draft talks include Iranian commitments and negotiations over enrichment suspension and highly enriched uranium disposition.

latest_news.headline: Russia launches Oreshnik in heavy Ukraine barrage
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Russia used Oreshnik, Iskander, Kinzhal and Zircon missiles in one of the heaviest attacks of the war, with large drone salvos against Kyiv-region targets.

latest_news.headline: Nuclear-capable missile signaling persists

latest_news.headline: Gaza strikes continue under ceasefire framework
